# WOFF2 Font File

## Summary
The font specialization for WOFF2.
An instance is an uploaded realm file with card semantics: the binary lives at
the file URL while the card carries extracted metadata and renders with
format-aware templates.

## Shape
Extends `FontDef`. Adds no fields of its own. WOFF2 uses Brotli with a transformed glyf table, so the
sfnt cannot be recovered by inflating alone — the metadata a WOFF exposes on
index is not reachable here without a full decoder. It is a separate def from
WOFF precisely so that shortfall is visible rather than silent.

Accepts: `.woff2, font/woff2`

## Example
```ts
import { Woff2Def } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/woff2-font-def';

@field attachment = linksTo(Woff2Def);
```
Instances are created by upload (`createFileDef` wires the type from the
MIME type). Live examples need uploaded fixtures — `Spec` has no field that
accepts a file today (`linkedExamples` is `linksToMany(CardDef)`, and
`FileDef` is a sibling of `CardDef`), so the example check stays open for
every file def until `fileExamples` lands.
